ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7; no account flag against the driver (no fake arrival confirmation and no prior upheld no-show history that reaches the RD-6 threshold).
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation was made by the driver, so the fee's validity runs through NS-0 to NS-1/NS-2 [F4][NS-0]. Both sides now converge on the arithmetic: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 14:14:10 while 41 m from the pickup, satisfying NS-1 (i) and (ii), but the wait after that tap ran only to the 14:15:50 cancellation [F6][F4][NS-1]. That is 1 min 40 s inside the radius; even measured from the platform-recorded arrival at 14:13:25 it is 2 min 25 s, and the stationary window was only 2 min 0 s [F5][F2][F3][NS-1]. NS-1 (iii) requires more than 3 minutes continuously at the pickup after the arrival confirmation, so the requirement fails on every reading of the record.

Because NS-1 (i)(ii) are met but (iii) is not, NS-2 requires the $6.61 cancellation fee to be refunded in full [F7][NS-2]. The amount is fixed by the fare fact: cancellation fee charged $6.61, surge 1.0× so no other charge is in play [F7][F8][NS-2]. The driver's chat "3 min up, cancelling the trip" and his post-trip statement that he waited and cancelled as a no-show are statements, and they yield to the system timeline [F10][F12][F6][F4]; they do not create the missing waiting time.

No ancillary account flag is warranted. NS-2's flag attaches where the driver pressed "I'm Here" while outside the pickup radius (m_from_pickup_at_tap > 200 m), and the trace records 41 m with no fake confirmation, so that condition is not met [F6][F1][NS-2]. RD-6 requires an upheld route deviation in the last 90 days plus this case; the driver's profile shows route disputes upheld = 0 [F17][RD-6]. The single prior upheld no-show dispute does not convert this overcharge into "repeated" route deviation, so no flag_account [F17][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read both chat messages, the driver's written statement and the rider's complaint. The messages are a plain arrival notice ("I'm here at the pickup point, white Honda Vezel") and a cancellation notice ("3 min up, cancelling the trip"); the statement is a version of events; the complaint is a fee grievance [F9][F10][F11][F12]. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so the screen returns none and no escalation on safety grounds [F9][F10][F11].

Evidence is sufficient: the record settles every element of the NS-1/NS-2 test — who cancelled [F4], the arrival confirmation with its distance and time [F6][F5], the continuous GPS coverage without a hole (trace) and the charged fee [F7]. The chat record is complete and fully timestamped [F11], so nothing needs to go to a person.

rejected_claims.reason: The claim that the record refutes the rider's 'barely two minutes' complaint is wrong on the numbers: measured from the platform arrival at 14:13:25 to cancellation at 14:15:50 is 2 min 25 s, and the stationary window is 2 min 0 s, both below the more-than-3-minute requirement in NS-1 (iii) [F5][F2][F3][NS-1]. Its NS-4 citation is inapposite because the cancellation was by the driver, routed by NS-0 to NS-1/NS-2 [F4][NS-0].

No traffic incident (F13) or speed-band record (F14) and fair weather (F15) do not support the driver's defence and do not bear on the timing point, which is settled against the fee by NS-1 (iii); this was conceded on both sides [F13][F14][F15][NS-1].

Accepted insofar as there is no SAFE-1/SAFE-2 trigger in the chat or statement [F9][F10][F11], but a clean chat does not create the waiting time NS-1 (iii) requires, so it does not support keeping the fee [F6][F4][NS-1].

The ancillary flag_account request is rejected: NS-2's flag applies only where the arrival tap was made outside the pickup radius, and the record shows 41 m [F6][NS-2]; RD-6 needs an upheld route deviation in the last 90 days, and the driver's route upheld count is 0 [F17][RD-6]. The rider's and driver's profile facts cannot decide the case on their own [F16][F17][RD-6].
